description:
⬇️ Get my e-book here! ⬇️


I'm Ralph Harmon. I've been prepping since 2009, through four extended outages, the longest one lasting nine days, and after each one I sit down and write out what actually failed instead of what I'd planned for on paper.
This channel is what came out of those notebooks. Fuel running short, the grid going down, water stopping, a freezer full of food going warm, the stuff that happens to ordinary households during ordinary disasters, not the end-of-the-world scenarios nobody actually lives through. Every video breaks down why a system fails the way it does and gives you the specific setup or habit that gets a family through it without turning the garage into a bunker.
